title: Nguyen emotional process
goal: Show a Bowen-oriented map of cutoff, fusion, conflict, distance, and closeness.

rubric.must: Minh and Lan visibly connect as parents of Anh, Bao, and Chi.
A visibly broken cutoff line labelled Estranged connects Minh and Anh.
A visibly multi-line fused relationship labelled Over-involved connects Lan and Chi.
Conflict, distant, and close relationships are visually distinguishable for the named pairs.
Chi alone visibly carries the index-person marker.

ideal.notes: Minh and Lan are the parents of Anh, Bao and index person Chi; Anh and David are the parents of Oliver. Smooth emotional arcs show Minh–Anh cutoff labelled Estranged, Lan–Chi three-line fusion labelled Over-involved, Minh–Bao conflict, Bao–Chi distance and Anh–Oliver closeness.
